prompts.envelope: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photorealistic envelope material for a layered interactive wedding invitation. Create a premium physical closed wedding envelope, back/flap side facing the camera, perfectly straight-on orthographic overhead, no perspective tilt or rotation. Landscape rectangle aspect ratio exactly 1.62:1. Burnt orange #ab501c dyed-through thick cotton rag paper, beautifully tactile very fine paper fibers, subtle color variations, crisp but natural thick folded edges, delicate creases and realistic occlusion shadows along the folds. A large triangular closing flap goes from the upper left corner across the upper right corner to a central point at 58 percent of the envelope height. Side and lower folded paper construction visible with deep, fine shadow seams, subtly dimensional but tasteful. Diffused daylight from upper left, realistic editorial macro product photography, luxury handcrafted wedding stationery. Isolated on genuinely transparent background, envelope occupies almost all image width with only a tiny transparent margin. No wax seal: the seal will be a separate movable layer. No text, initials, logos, props, ribbon, floral decorations or background. It must look photographed, never like a smooth vector illustration or plastic digital render.
prompts.seal: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent wax seal cutout for a premium wedding invitation. Extreme close-up, perfectly top-down orthographic photograph of one real hand-poured chocolate-brown sealing wax seal, warm dark brown #583426, subtle copper reflections, irregular naturally pooled outline and thicker uneven rim, small authentic ripples, tiny air imperfections, softly satin wax rather than shiny plastic. The center bears the exact intertwined serif monogram "TM", deeply physically impressed into the wax by a brass stamp, letters made of the same brown wax with realistic inset shadows and narrow warm highlights, NOT printed or overlaid lettering and NOT a coin or a metal medallion. A faint imperfect circular stamp impression surrounds the monogram. Soft directional window light from upper left, finely visible relief and thickness, premium handcrafted artisan wax stationery, incredibly realistic macro photography. Seal fills about 85 percent of a square frame. Genuinely transparent background outside the seal, only a tiny natural contact shadow, no envelope, no hands, no extra objects, no border, no watermark.
